verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a built-in chat assistant inside pull requests. Users can talk to it, delegate remediation through 'Fix with Chat Agent', or let Qodo apply a fix directly. However, delegation is documented only for review findings within the PR context, and the general-purpose Qodo Command agent appears only in community benchmark discussion. Missing for 10: documented general task delegation beyond PR finding fixes, details on scope and depth of what the chat agent can carry out, and independent hands-on corroboration of the in-PR assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Chat with Qodo to interact with Qodo directly inside pull requests.
Use Fix with Chat Agent to remediate issues while you chat with Qodo.
let Qodo apply the fix directly.
